name: FFS_RESOURCE_LOG
description: Stores a modification history for the corresponding parent table.

columns.name: LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the log record.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Reference to action log identifier.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Reference to user which made changes.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the resource the log record is created for.

columns.name: PACTIVE
columns.description: Resource log record resource status flag (active,inactive).

columns.name: PARENT
columns.description: F.k. provider.pid. Contains id of the parent provider. If this provider is top provider then parent=0.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: External ID (Using via angel.com). Technician number (Charter).

columns.name: PTYPE
columns.description: Provider log record provider type.

columns.name: PCAPACITY_BUCKET
columns.description: Provider log record assigned capacity bucket.

columns.name: PNAME
columns.description: Provider log record Name of reouce in Resource Tree.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: ID of the organization this resource belongs to.

columns.name: PLANGUAGE
columns.description: Provider language. F.k. language.lid.

columns.name: PTIME_FID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a preferred time format for the resource.

columns.name: PDATE_FID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a preferred date format for the resource.

columns.name: TIME_ZONE
columns.description: Provider time zone. F.k. time_zone.zid.

columns.name: EMAIL
columns.description: Resource log record resource email.

columns.name: PPHONE
columns.description: Provider log record ground phone.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Resource log record resource creation time.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Resource last update time in GMT time zone.

columns.name: TRAVEL_KEY
columns.description: Resource travel key. Calculated automatically based on configured 'Resource Travel Key' on Business Rules screen.

columns.name: PDURATIONKEY
columns.description: Resource duration key. Calculated automatically based on configured 'Resource Duration Key' on Business Rules screen.

columns.name: PSTARTTIMEKEY
columns.description: Resource Start Time key. Calculated automatically based on configured 'Start Time Key' on Business Rules screen.

columns.name: P_RPRID
columns.description: Provider log record routing profile.

columns.name: PFEATURES
columns.description: List of features configured for selected resource type.

columns.name: PCOLOR
columns.description: Resource's color on Resource Tree screen in case of resource incopmliance.

columns.name: PINITIAL_RATIO_READ_ONLY
columns.description: Initial ratio read only if set, initial ratio for activity duration cannot be modified.

columns.name: PINITIAL_RATIO
columns.description: Initial ratio for activity duration for new provider.

columns.name: SKIP_DAYS_FOR_STATS
columns.description: Skip first n days for learning statistics.

columns.name: SKIP_DAYS_UPDATED
columns.description: Last date when skip_days_for_stats was updated.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
